ko.slowmo.desc: KO slow-motion speed (1 = normal). Visual only; the match is already over.

ko.dropMs.desc: Drop KO (jab, chip, any sour hit): real ms for the fall.

ko.flyMs.desc: Fly KO (sweet Cross/Hook, any Uppercut): real ms of flight to the ropes.

ko.sitMs.desc: Fly KO: real ms to slump into the sitting pose after reaching the ropes.

ko.flyMaxDistance.desc: Fly KO: max px travelled (stops earlier at the ropes).

ko.resultDelayMs.desc: Pause after the KO animation before the result screen.

punches.jab.startup.desc: Jab: frames before the fist moves. Lower = faster.

punches.jab.sourEarly.desc: Jab: early-sour frames while the fist extends (jammed zone).

punches.jab.sweet.desc: Jab: sweet frames at full extension.

punches.jab.sour.desc: Jab: late-sour frames after the sweet spot.

punches.jab.recovery.desc: Jab: frames to recover after the active frames (Vulnerable).

punches.jab.whiffRecovery.desc: Jab: extra recovery frames on a miss (punish window).

punches.jab.reach.desc: Jab: distance the fist travels at full extension (px).

punches.jab.hitRadius.desc: Jab: size of the fist hitbox (px).

punches.jab.damage.desc: Jab: full damage of a clean hit.

punches.jab.staminaCost.desc: Jab: stamina the attacker spends to throw it.

punches.jab.staminaDamage.desc: Jab: stamina the defender loses when hit/blocking.

punches.jab.stunBuild.desc: Jab: stun meter added to the defender on a direct hit.

punches.jab.startReachFrac.desc: Jab: where the fist starts extending (0-1 of reach). Higher = shorter jammed zone.

punches.cross.startup.desc: Cross: frames before the fist moves. Lower = faster.

punches.cross.sourEarly.desc: Cross: early-sour frames while the fist extends (jammed zone).

punches.cross.sweet.desc: Cross: sweet frames at full extension.

punches.cross.sour.desc: Cross: late-sour frames after the sweet spot.

punches.cross.recovery.desc: Cross: frames to recover after the active frames (Vulnerable).

punches.cross.whiffRecovery.desc: Cross: extra recovery frames on a miss (punish window).

punches.cross.reach.desc: Cross: distance the fist travels at full extension (px).

punches.cross.hitRadius.desc: Cross: size of the fist hitbox (px).

punches.cross.damage.desc: Cross: full damage of a clean hit.

punches.cross.staminaCost.desc: Cross: stamina the attacker spends to throw it.

punches.cross.staminaDamage.desc: Cross: stamina the defender loses when hit/blocking.

punches.cross.stunBuild.desc: Cross: stun meter added to the defender on a direct hit.

punches.cross.startReachFrac.desc: Cross: where the fist starts extending (0-1 of reach). Higher = shorter jammed zone.

punches.hook.startup.desc: Hook: frames before the fist moves. Lower = faster.

punches.hook.sourEarly.desc: Hook: early-sour frames while the fist extends (jammed zone).

punches.hook.sweet.desc: Hook: sweet frames at full extension.

punches.hook.sour.desc: Hook: late-sour frames after the sweet spot.

punches.hook.recovery.desc: Hook: frames to recover after the active frames (Vulnerable).

punches.hook.whiffRecovery.desc: Hook: extra recovery frames on a miss (punish window).

punches.hook.reach.desc: Hook: distance the fist travels at full extension (px).

punches.hook.hitRadius.desc: Hook: size of the fist hitbox (px).

punches.hook.damage.desc: Hook: full damage of a clean hit.

punches.hook.staminaCost.desc: Hook: stamina the attacker spends to throw it.

punches.hook.staminaDamage.desc: Hook: stamina the defender loses when hit/blocking.

punches.hook.stunBuild.desc: Hook: stun meter added to the defender on a direct hit.

punches.hook.startReachFrac.desc: Hook: where the fist starts extending (0-1 of reach). Higher = shorter jammed zone.

punches.uppercut.startup.desc: Uppercut: frames before the fist moves. Lower = faster.

punches.uppercut.sourEarly.desc: Uppercut: early-sour frames while the fist extends (jammed zone).

punches.uppercut.sweet.desc: Uppercut: sweet frames at full extension.

punches.uppercut.sour.desc: Uppercut: late-sour frames after the sweet spot.

punches.uppercut.recovery.desc: Uppercut: frames to recover after the active frames (Vulnerable).

punches.uppercut.whiffRecovery.desc: Uppercut: extra recovery frames on a miss (punish window).

punches.uppercut.reach.desc: Uppercut: distance the fist travels at full extension (px).

punches.uppercut.hitRadius.desc: Uppercut: size of the fist hitbox (px).

punches.uppercut.staminaCost.desc: Uppercut: stamina the attacker spends to throw it.

punches.uppercut.staminaDamage.desc: Uppercut: stamina the defender loses when hit/blocking.

punches.uppercut.stunBuild.desc: Uppercut: stun meter added to the defender on a direct hit.

punches.uppercut.startReachFrac.desc: Uppercut: where the fist starts extending (0-1 of reach). Higher = shorter jammed zone.

punches.hook.guardChipMult.desc: Hook: share of its damage that chips through High Guard.

punches.uppercut.crossDamageMult.desc: Uppercut: damage as a multiple of the Cross damage.

hit.reducedDamageMult.desc: Reduced damage as a share of full (body hits, sour on face).

hit.attackerStaminaPenalty.desc: Stamina the attacker loses when blocked / on sour vs Normal.

hit.counterDamageMult.desc: Damage multiplier for Cross/Hook counters on the opponent's startup.

hit.sourStunMult.desc: Stun build of a sour hit, as a share of a sweet hit.

stars.max.desc: Stars needed to unlock the Uppercut.

fatigue.perUse.desc: Fatigue added each time a punch type is thrown.

fatigue.decayPerSec.desc: Fatigue that wears off per second once the decay pause has passed.

fatigue.freeUses.desc: Repeats of a punch type allowed before its fatigue bars start to fill.

guard.perfectFrames.desc: Frames after raising guard that count as a Perfect Guard.

guard.staminaDrainPerSec.desc: Stamina drained per second while holding High Guard.

guard.perfectGuardStaminaGain.desc: Stamina the defender gains on a Perfect Guard.

guard.perfectGuardAttackerStunFrames.desc: Frames the attacker is staggered after hitting a Perfect Guard.

guard.perfectGuardStunBuild.desc: Stun meter added to the attacker on a Perfect Guard.

dodge.iFrames.desc: Invincible frames at the start of a dodge.

dodge.vulnerableFrames.desc: Vulnerable frames after a dodge ends.

dodge.stunnedVulnerableMult.desc: Multiplier on post-dodge Vulnerable while stunned.

dodge.neutralDeadzone.desc: Stick tilt below this dodges backwards (backstep).

body.coreRadius.desc: Core (face) radius. Hits reaching it use the full-damage row.

stun.threshold.desc: Stun meter needed to be stunned.

stun.decayPerSec.desc: Stun meter lost per second when not being hit.

stun.decayDelayFrames.desc: Frames after a hit before stun starts decaying.

stun.overflowFramesPerPoint.desc: Extra stun frames per point over the threshold.

stamina.regenIdlePerSec.desc: Regen per second with no input at all.

stamina.regenActivePerSec.desc: Regen per second while moving (not attacking).

stamina.regenDelayFrames.desc: Frames after spending stamina before regen starts.

stamina.exhaustRecoverAt.desc: After hitting 0, Vulnerable until stamina climbs back to this.

movement.minSeparation.desc: Closest the two boxers can stand (px).

input.bufferFrames.desc: Frames a press is remembered while busy (input buffer).

input.joystickDeadzone.desc: Stick tilt ignored near the centre.

match.durationSec.desc: Round length in seconds. Timeout: higher health % wins.

match.startDistance.desc: Distance between the boxers at the start of a round (px).

net.pingSamples.desc: Online: pings taken to pick the delay.

net.connectTimeoutMs.desc: Online: give up joining after this long (ms).

net.turnFetchTimeoutMs.desc: Online: max wait for TURN credentials (ms).

net.stallIndicatorMs.desc: Online: show "waiting for opponent" after a stall this long (ms). Stalls only happen past the rollback window.

training.dummyInfiniteStamina.desc: Dummy never runs out of stamina (keeps High Guard up).

dodge.buffWindowFrames.desc: After a dodge ends, a punch thrown within this many frames is powered up.

dodge.buffDamageMult.desc: Damage multiplier for that powered-up punch after a dodge.

hit.hitstopFrames.desc: Hit-stop: frames the whole fight freezes on a damaging hit (counters x2). 0 = off.

ai.reactionFrames.desc: AI: Frames before the AI reacts to what you do (lower = harder).

ai.attackRange.desc: AI: Distance at which the AI starts throwing punches (px).

ai.attackChance.desc: AI: Chance per frame to attack when in range and ready.

ai.attackCooldownFrames.desc: AI: Minimum frames between AI attacks.

ai.jabWeight.desc: AI: How often the AI picks a Jab.

ai.crossWeight.desc: AI: How often the AI picks a Cross.

ai.hookWeight.desc: AI: How often the AI picks a Hook (close range).

ai.guardChance.desc: AI: Chance the AI raises guard when it sees you start a punch.

ai.guardHoldFrames.desc: AI: How long the AI holds guard once raised.

ai.dodgeChance.desc: AI: Chance the AI dodges instead of guarding.

ai.retreatStaminaBelow.desc: AI: AI backs off when its stamina is below this.

match.introSec.desc: READY... GO! countdown before a round (seconds). Nobody can move until GO. 0 = off.

punches.jab.fatigueBars.desc: Jab: fatigue bars (max fatigue level) shown on its button.

punches.jab.fatigueSpeedPerBar.desc: Jab: startup/recovery slowdown per lit fatigue bar (0.12 = +12%).

punches.jab.fatigueDamagePerBar.desc: Jab: damage lost per lit fatigue bar (0.1 = -10%).

punches.hook.fatigueBars.desc: Hook: fatigue bars (max fatigue level) shown on its button.

punches.hook.fatigueSpeedPerBar.desc: Hook: startup/recovery slowdown per lit fatigue bar (0.12 = +12%).

punches.hook.fatigueDamagePerBar.desc: Hook: damage lost per lit fatigue bar (0.1 = -10%).

punches.cross.fatigueBars.desc: Cross: fatigue bars (max fatigue level) shown on its button.

punches.cross.fatigueSpeedPerBar.desc: Cross: startup/recovery slowdown per lit fatigue bar (0.12 = +12%).

punches.cross.fatigueDamagePerBar.desc: Cross: damage lost per lit fatigue bar (0.1 = -10%).

fatigue.decayDelayFrames.desc: Fatigue of a punch type only starts wearing off after this many frames without throwing it (repeating always builds).

net.inputDelayFrames.desc: Online: local input delay in frames (rollback hides the rest). Higher = fewer corrections, more sluggish.

net.maxRollbackFrames.desc: Online: how far behind the opponent may be before the game waits (frames). Higher = fewer freezes, bigger corrections.

hit.pushFrames.desc: Pushback: ticks the knockback is spread over (smooth slide, not a teleport).

punches.jab.pushHit.desc: Jab: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.jab.pushBlock.desc: Jab: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked.

punches.cross.pushHit.desc: Cross: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.cross.pushBlock.desc: Cross: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked.

punches.hook.pushHit.desc: Hook: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.hook.pushBlock.desc: Hook: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked.

punches.uppercut.pushHit.desc: Uppercut: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.uppercut.pushBlock.desc: Uppercut: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked. (Uppercut cannot be blocked.)

stars.counterGain.desc: Stars gained for landing a counter (a sweet non-counter hit gives 1).

characters.marco.stun.desc: Marco: stun threshold multiplier (higher = harder to stun).

characters.marco.jab.startup.desc: Marco jab: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.jab.recovery.desc: Marco jab: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.jab.fatigueBars.desc: Marco jab: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.marco.cross.startup.desc: Marco cross: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.cross.recovery.desc: Marco cross: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.cross.fatigueBars.desc: Marco cross: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.marco.hook.startup.desc: Marco hook: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.hook.recovery.desc: Marco hook: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.hook.fatigueBars.desc: Marco hook: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.marco.uppercut.startup.desc: Marco uppercut: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.uppercut.recovery.desc: Marco uppercut: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.marco.uppercut.fatigueBars.desc: Marco uppercut: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.mia.jab.startup.desc: Mia jab: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.jab.recovery.desc: Mia jab: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.jab.fatigueBars.desc: Mia jab: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.mia.cross.startup.desc: Mia cross: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.cross.recovery.desc: Mia cross: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.cross.fatigueBars.desc: Mia cross: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.mia.hook.startup.desc: Mia hook: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.hook.recovery.desc: Mia hook: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.hook.fatigueBars.desc: Mia hook: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.mia.uppercut.startup.desc: Mia uppercut: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.uppercut.recovery.desc: Mia uppercut: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.mia.uppercut.fatigueBars.desc: Mia uppercut: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.bruno.stun.desc: Bruno: stun threshold multiplier (higher = harder to stun).

characters.bruno.jab.startup.desc: Bruno jab: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.jab.recovery.desc: Bruno jab: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.jab.fatigueBars.desc: Bruno jab: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.bruno.cross.startup.desc: Bruno cross: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.cross.recovery.desc: Bruno cross: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.cross.fatigueBars.desc: Bruno cross: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.bruno.hook.startup.desc: Bruno hook: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.hook.recovery.desc: Bruno hook: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.hook.fatigueBars.desc: Bruno hook: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

characters.bruno.uppercut.startup.desc: Bruno uppercut: startup frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.uppercut.recovery.desc: Bruno uppercut: recovery frames added (keep within -2..+2).

characters.bruno.uppercut.fatigueBars.desc: Bruno uppercut: extra fatigue bars before max penalty.

match.tagSec.desc: P1 / P2 tags over the boxers: seconds after GO before they finish fading.

hit.pushLockFrames.desc: Pushback: ticks the defender can't walk after a push lands (dodge still works). Can be longer than the slide.

ai.medium.reactionFrames.desc: Medium bot: frames the bot sees the fight late (lower = sharper).

ai.medium.attackChance.desc: Medium bot: chance per frame to start an attack when off cooldown.

ai.medium.attackCooldownFrames.desc: Medium bot: frames between its attacks.

ai.medium.guardChance.desc: Medium bot: chance to guard a punch it saw start.

ai.medium.guardHoldFrames.desc: Medium bot: frames it holds guard.

ai.medium.dodgeChance.desc: Medium bot: chance to dodge a punch it saw start.

ai.medium.uppercutDodgeChance.desc: Medium bot: chance to dodge a charged uppercut it saw start.

ai.medium.pgChance.desc: Medium bot: chance, rolled once per incoming punch, to try a Perfect Guard.

ai.medium.counterChance.desc: Medium bot: chance to jab-interrupt a slow wind-up.

ai.medium.punishChance.desc: Medium bot: chance per frame to hit an exposed foe (recovery / exhausted / stunned).

ai.medium.retreatStaminaBelow.desc: Medium bot: stamina under which it backs off.

ai.medium.strafePeriod.desc: Medium bot: frames per sideways drift cycle.

ai.medium.cornerAvoid.desc: Medium bot: how hard it steers back to the centre near the ropes.

ai.hard.reactionFrames.desc: Hard bot: frames the bot sees the fight late (lower = sharper).

ai.hard.attackChance.desc: Hard bot: chance per frame to start an attack when off cooldown.

ai.hard.attackCooldownFrames.desc: Hard bot: frames between its attacks.

ai.hard.guardChance.desc: Hard bot: chance to guard a punch it saw start.

ai.hard.guardHoldFrames.desc: Hard bot: frames it holds guard.

ai.hard.dodgeChance.desc: Hard bot: chance to dodge a punch it saw start.

ai.hard.uppercutDodgeChance.desc: Hard bot: chance to dodge a charged uppercut it saw start.

ai.hard.pgChance.desc: Hard bot: chance, rolled once per incoming punch, to try a Perfect Guard.

ai.hard.counterChance.desc: Hard bot: chance to jab-interrupt a slow wind-up.

ai.hard.punishChance.desc: Hard bot: chance per frame to hit an exposed foe (recovery / exhausted / stunned).

ai.hard.retreatStaminaBelow.desc: Hard bot: stamina under which it backs off.

ai.hard.strafePeriod.desc: Hard bot: frames per sideways drift cycle.

ai.hard.cornerAvoid.desc: Hard bot: how hard it steers back to the centre near the ropes.

ai.medium.pgMistime.desc: Medium bot: chance a Perfect Guard attempt is mistimed (raised early, so only a normal block).

ai.medium.pgHesitateFrames.desc: Medium bot: frames it holds off attacking after a Perfect Guard attempt (a human-like pause).

ai.hard.pgMistime.desc: Hard bot: chance a Perfect Guard attempt is mistimed (raised early, so only a normal block).

ai.hard.pgHesitateFrames.desc: Hard bot: frames it holds off attacking after a Perfect Guard attempt (a human-like pause).

view.perspective.desc: Ring perspective on/off (1 / 0). Pure presentation: the sim arena stays a flat square, only the picture of it is tilted.

view.topScale.desc: Width of the far (top) ring edge relative to the near (bottom) edge. 1 = no taper.

view.squash.desc: Vertical squash of the ring picture (1 = none). Lower looks flatter, as if viewed at a lower angle.

view.shadowOffsetY.desc: Ground shadow drop below the boxer, in screen Y (world px). Raises the body off the floor so the tilt reads as depth.

view.shadowSize.desc: Ground shadow size relative to the boxer body.

view.feetOffsetY.desc: Feet layer drop below the body, in screen Y (world px). 0 = feet directly under the body.

net.enhanced.desc: Online experiment, host authoritative (guests adopt the host value at match start). 0 = rollback as before. 1 = stick and guard use net.moveDelayFrames while punches keep the full input delay, drawn positions ease after a rollback, and the punch delay adapts to the measured ping.

net.moveDelayFrames.desc: Enhanced only: input delay for stick and guard (frames). Punches and dodges keep the full delay, so they are buffered by the startup frames. Lower = snappier movement, more corrections.

net.smoothFrames.desc: Enhanced only: after a rollback, ease each boxer's drawn position back over this many frames instead of snapping (picture only, the sim is exact). 0 = off.

net.adaptFactor.desc: Enhanced only: the punch delay follows the measured one-way ping times this factor (in frames). Higher hides more latency from the opponent but feels slower for you.

net.adaptMaxFrames.desc: Enhanced only: the most the adaptive punch delay may reach (frames).

view.headOffsetY.desc: Layered boxer: head drop in screen Y (world px). Negative = higher on screen. Gloves stay at 0; torso, feet and shadow sit below.

view.bodyOffsetY.desc: Layered boxer: torso drop in screen Y (world px). Gloves stay at 0, the head sits above and the feet and shadow below.

view.puppet.torsoHeight.desc: Shoulder-to-shoulder torso image height at character scale 1. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.headHeight.desc: Head image height at character scale 1. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.gloveHeight.desc: Glove cuff-to-knuckle image height at character scale 1. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.bootWidth.desc: Boot image length at character scale 1. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.shoulderSpread.desc: Distance of shoulder sockets from the facing axis. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.hipSpread.desc: Distance of hip sockets from the facing axis. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.bootSpread.desc: Resting boot distance from the facing axis. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.leadBootForward.desc: Lead boot position along facing; positive is forward. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.rearBootForward.desc: Rear boot position along facing; negative is behind. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.headForward.desc: Head position along the facing axis. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.sweatRadius.desc: Exhaustion droplet radius at character scale 1. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.puppet.sweatHighlightRadius.desc: Exhaustion droplet highlight radius at character scale 1. Presentation only; does not change hitboxes or reach.

view.trainingDummy.bodyHeight.desc: Dummy torso pad height. Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

view.trainingDummy.headHeight.desc: Dummy head pad height. Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

view.trainingDummy.headForward.desc: Head overlap along facing. Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

view.trainingDummy.shakeMs.desc: Struck pad shake duration (ms). Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

view.trainingDummy.shakeHz.desc: Struck pad shake frequency (Hz). Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

view.trainingDummy.shakeDistance.desc: Struck pad lateral displacement. Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

view.trainingDummy.shakeAngle.desc: Struck pad angular displacement (radians). Presentation only; dummy hitboxes stay fixed.

dodge.penaltyMoveMult.desc: Walking speed multiplier during the post-dodge penalty.

view.staminaRejectFlashMs.desc: Duration of the empty-stamina red rejection flash in milliseconds.

view.staminaRejectFlashHz.desc: Pulse frequency of the empty-stamina rejection flash.

guard.penaltyFrames.desc: Vulnerable frames after lowering guard; guard cannot be raised during this penalty.

view.puppet.walkPhasePerPixel.desc: Foot gait phase per pixel walked; 0.21 is 40% slower than the former 0.35.

view.puppet.hookWindupDegrees.desc: Hook wind-up angle outward from facing; mirrored for either hand.

view.puppet.hookFollowDegrees.desc: Hook follow-through angle inward across facing.

view.puppet.hookSnapPower.desc: Hook sweep easing exponent; higher values snap across sooner.

view.puppet.hookElbowRatio.desc: Minimum hook arm segment length relative to shoulder/glove distance, keeping the elbow bent.

view.puppet.uppercutFireWidth.desc: Width of the flame covering the uppercut arm and glove.

view.puppet.uppercutFireLength.desc: Flame tongue length beyond the uppercut glove.

view.puppet.uppercutFireFadeFrames.desc: Presentation frames for uppercut flames to fade after the active strike.

view.puppet.uppercutFireFlickerHz.desc: Uppercut flame flicker and ember frequency.

view.puppet.torsoTwistDegrees.desc: Torso turn toward the striking arm at full extension (degrees); the head follows 40%. Visual only.

view.flashMs.desc: How long a boxer flashes when hit, in ms (white = you landed it, red = you took it; head and torso flash separately).

view.puppet.vulnerablePulseMs.desc: Vulnerable red-orange pulse: speed divisor in ms (lower = faster).

view.puppet.vulnerablePulseMax.desc: Vulnerable red-orange pulse: strongest tint (0 = none, 1 = solid red-orange).

view.flashStrobeMs.desc: Hit flash strobe: how long each of the two flash colours shows, in ms (white and red when damage landed, red and dark red when it did not).

ai.medium.recoverUntil.desc: Medium bot: once low on stamina it stays in recovery (safe spot, standing still) until it is back above this.

ai.medium.conserveBelow.desc: Medium bot: under this stamina it attacks less and prefers cheap punches (it keeps a reserve).

ai.medium.safeDistance.desc: Medium bot: distance from the foe at which it considers itself safe while recovering (px).

ai.medium.edgeMargin.desc: Medium bot: how far from the ropes it wants to stay while recovering (px).

ai.hard.recoverUntil.desc: Hard bot: once low on stamina it stays in recovery (safe spot, standing still) until it is back above this.

ai.hard.conserveBelow.desc: Hard bot: under this stamina it attacks less and prefers cheap punches (it keeps a reserve).

ai.hard.safeDistance.desc: Hard bot: distance from the foe at which it considers itself safe while recovering (px).

ai.hard.edgeMargin.desc: Hard bot: how far from the ropes it wants to stay while recovering (px).

ai.medium.pressureFoeBelow.desc: Medium bot: when the foe stamina is under this it presses in and attacks more (0 = never).

ai.medium.pressureBoost.desc: Medium bot: attack chance multiplier while pressing a low-stamina foe.

ai.hard.pressureFoeBelow.desc: Hard bot: when the foe stamina is under this it presses in and attacks more (0 = never).

ai.hard.pressureBoost.desc: Hard bot: attack chance multiplier while pressing a low-stamina foe.
